notes.chart_dependency: echarts@6.1.0 (exact-pinned), imported tree-shaken from echarts/core. zrender@6.1.0 is its transitive same-family dependency. No echarts-for-react. No second charting family.
notes.fixtures_added: Eight result-population detail envelopes captured verbatim from the UNCHANGED merged API (GET /api/research/result-populations/{id}) via FastAPI TestClient, the same provenance path used for every pre-existing fixture. No API code was modified to produce them; the endpoint and apiClient.resultPopulation(id) already existed on main.
notes.new_numeric_surface: Per-variant metrics (return_pct, drawdown, sharpe, win_rate, trade_count) are now charted. Every value is a committed artifact field read verbatim from offline_research runs with offline_only=true, no_runtime_contact=true, no_paper_live_contact=true. No chart sorts by a metric, selects a best variant, or draws a threshold line.
notes.not_drawn: Equity curve, drawdown-over-time, walk-forward folds, Monte Carlo paths, and per-trade distributions are NOT drawn. Robustness statistics (PSR, DSR, MinTRL) are named as withheld by the committed report artifacts and no value for them is exposed or plotted. EquityCurveChart and RobustnessDistributionChart were deliberately not created as components.
notes.report_charting_flag: The reports' committed withheld.charting.enabled=false flag governs the report artifact's own embedded output and is left untouched and still surfaced. Only the count blocks the envelope already exposes are charted on the dashboard side.
notes.audit: npm audit --omit=dev is unchanged from baseline at 2 vulnerabilities (1 high, 1 moderate), both pre-existing in the next dependency chain and fixable only by a next@16 semver-major bump that is out of scope. echarts and zrender are not flagged. Nothing was suppressed; npm audit fix --force was not run.
notes.chart_interactions: Hover tooltips and legend series-toggle only. Both repaint a canvas and reach nothing outside it. ECharts toolbox, dataZoom, brush, markLine, and markArea are deliberately not registered.
notes.visual_verification_limit: Browser console could not be read (Chrome extension not connected). Verified instead: production build passes, all 10 chart routes return HTTP 200, every chart host server-renders with row counts matching the committed artifacts, and the server log is free of errors.
